```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(eval.after = c("fig.cap"))
knitr::opts_hooks$set(fig.cap = function(options) { if (is.character(options$fig.cap)) options$fig.cap <- call("toupper", options$fig.cap); options })
```

```{r a, fig.cap="caption one"}
plot(1)
```

```{r b, engine="dot", fig.cap="caption two", eval=TRUE}
digraph { a -> b }
```
